description: This file defines the GeneratedBatchContainer class, which implements the IBatchContainer interface for generated event payloads within the Orleans streaming framework. It includes properties for stream identification, sequence tokens, enqueue time, and payload, as well as methods for retrieving events and importing request context.

classes.name: GeneratedBatchContainer
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IBatchContainer for generated event payloads, providing properties for stream ID, sequence token, enqueue time, payload, and methods to retrieve events and handle request context.

methods.name: GeneratedBatchContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the container with stream ID, payload, and token, setting the enqueue time to current UTC time.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Returns an enumerable with a single tuple containing the payload cast to type T and the sequence token.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Indicates whether the request context should be imported; always returns false in this implementation.
